profiles_description: Lists, creates, deletes and sets the default profile of the project.
profiles_option_skip: Selector to switch off in the new profile (separate several with commas).
profiles_option_label: Readable name of the new profile.
profiles_option_replace: Recreates a profile that already exists.
profiles_option_if_match: Expected revision (sha256) of the file; if it changed, the write is refused with a conflict.
profiles_usage: Use: jgates profiles list | create <id> --from <profile> [--skip <selector>] [--label <name>] [--replace] | save --run <runId> --as <id> | set-default <id> | delete <id>  [--if-match <hash>] [--cwd <project>] [--json] [--no-interactive]
profiles_unknown_action_fix: Use: jgates profiles list | create | save | set-default | delete
profiles_missing_from_fix: Use: jgates profiles create <id> --from <profile>, for example --from standard.
profiles_bad_cwd: The project folder does not exist or is not a folder: {path}
profiles_option_not_supported: The option --{name} does not apply to 'profiles {action}'.
profiles_config_invalid: The project configuration is invalid ({count} problem(s)); {first}
profiles_config_invalid_fix: Fix it with jgates config validate before touching the profiles.
profiles_id_invalid_fix: Use lowercase letters, numbers, dot, hyphen or underscore, starting with a letter or number.
profiles_exists_fix: Use --replace to recreate '{id}', or choose another id.
profiles_from_not_found: The starter profile '{from}' does not exist.
profiles_from_not_found_fix: See the profiles with jgates profiles list.
profiles_not_found_fix: See the profiles with jgates profiles list.
profiles_cycle: The profile '{id}' would inherit from itself through '{from}'.
profiles_cycle_fix: Choose a starting point that does not depend on the profile being recreated.
profiles_in_use_default: The profile '{id}' is the project default (selection.profile).
profiles_in_use_fix: Change the default with set-default or adjust the profiles that inherit it, and delete afterwards.
profiles_conflict: The file {file} changed since it was read; nothing was written.
profiles_conflict_fix: Read again with jgates profiles list --json and repeat with the new revision in --if-match.
profiles_patch_invalid_fix: Nothing was written. Check the file and the input.
profiles_option_run: Id of the run whose selection becomes a profile (profiles save).
profiles_option_as: Id of the new profile (profiles save).
profiles_save_missing_as: The id of the new profile (--as) is missing.
profiles_save_run_not_found: The run {run} does not exist in this workspace or did not keep the plan.
profiles_save_run_not_found_fix: Check the id in jgates history or in the data folder; the run must be from this project.
profiles_save_only: The run {run} used --only, which does not become a profile.
profiles_save_only_fix: Run again with --skip on the items to switch off and save that run, or use profiles create.
profiles_saved: Profile {id} saved to {file} from run {run}: base {from}, {count} selectors switched off.
